title: Three Christmases and One Short Stool
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：grandson　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grandson 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the old man ① taught a grandson that no cousin in the house would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the Christmas. The ② grandson, meaning the boy himself and not the letter, ran three Christmases and stayed undescribed in the book; a grandson, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ grandson in that house had the same short stool beside him, and the ④ grandson at the far hearth, meaning the one they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A grandson, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the old man said the describing is the part that fills three Christmases.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grandson was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the boy. The ⑥ grandson, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grandson, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a boy and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ grandson had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short stool. The ⑧ grandson of the whole thing, the old man wrote in November, was one house and three Christmases of describing; grandson, he said, is either the one at the far hearth or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grandson I remember is the one described in the diary, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ grandson, my mother said in 1979, is the only one that improves by being described; every grandson, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a boy. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 孙子；外孙（指房子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 孙子；外孙（指那个男孩本人，与信件相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach a grandson 教一个孙子
D. n. 孙子（指留给孩子们作伴的那一个）
E. n. 孙辈（抽象总称，指一座房子的孙辈之事）
F. n. 孙子（指日记里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 后生；接班人（指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 期盼（抽象总称，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught a grandson that no cousin in the house would have described
The grandson, meaning the boy himself and not the letter
the grandson at the far hearth
the grandson was the whole of the matter
the grandson had become a line in a diary
The grandson of the whole thing
A grandson, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: teach a grandson 意为“教一个孙子”，1970 年那位老人教了房子里没有一位表亲肯描述的一个孙子。
grandson 意为“孙子、外孙”，指那个男孩本人而不是信件，他经过了三个圣诞节而在簿子上没有被描述。
grandson 意为“孙子、外孙”，指房子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张矮矮的凳子。
grandson 意为“孙子”，指最远那个炉边留给孩子们作伴的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grandson 意为“后生、接班人”，指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位接班人就是那件事的全部。
grandson 意为“期盼”，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个孙子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grandson 意为“孙子”，指日记里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1975 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
grandson 意为“孙辈”，老人十一月写道，整件事的孙辈之事是一座房子和三个圣诞节的描述。
grandson 意为“孙子”，我记得的是日记里描述过的那一个，1977 年长大了，至今仍被说成房子里最安静的一个。
grandson 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，一个孙子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
